Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5197 of 2023
Applicant :- Ajay Kumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arun Kumar Vishvakarma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.- 313 of 2021, registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC, Police Station- Kamla Nagar, District- Agra, during pendency of the trial.

It is alleged in the FIR that applicant applied for examination conducted by SSC Board 2020-21,
when the examination was started, staff of the examination centre arrested two accused persons who were appearing on different candidates and they were not real candidates.
The applicant was not arrested from the place of occurrence.

It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case as he did not go to appear in the examination only he applied for examination.
The allegation against the applicant that he sent some other person to appear in the examination, is without any evidence.

Learned counsel for the Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12426039/
1 applicant next argued that co-accused Abhishek, Ramakant @ Ramkant and Sonu Yadav have been granted bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Hon'ble Court by orders dated 28.03.2022,
07.04.2022 and 19.11.2022 respectively.

entities.text: Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no previous criminal history as stated in Para 26 of the affidavit of bail application.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 30.12.2022.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Ajay Kumar, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Rama Kant  Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12426039/
